content.question: Which normalization type is widely used in style transfer and generation applications, and why?
options: Instance normalization - it removes instance-specific contrast information, emphasizing content over style.
Batch normalization - it removes the need for mini-batches.
Layer normalization - it merges the style of all samples together.
Group normalization - it splits each image into styled groups.
content.answer: Instance normalization - it removes instance-specific contrast information, emphasizing content over style.
